criteria.evidence: Skill used 2x; turn 0: 'I'll start the first review pass.' then 'First pass applied one fix... Running the second pass.'

Pass 1 and pass 2 findings fixed in turn 0; the two deferred findings were resolved in turn 1 after the user delegated ('your call'): #1 fixed with the approval guard, #2 explicitly kept per design decision 3 with documentation updated.
Commits e595506, 00182dd, d4609b0 made; push impossible ('no remotes configured'), stated each time and accepted by the user; final work committed in turn 5.
Diff adds script/enableAutoMerge.js and the step body becomes `const script = require('./script/enableAutoMerge.js'); await script({ core, context, github })`.
16-line header block removed and replaced with a 3-line note; emulated user accepted ('Good, that covers it').
Script structured as fetchPullRequest, hasApprovingReview, commitsBehindBase, updateBranchFromBase, enableAutoMerge plus a short entry point; ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE_MUTATION constant.

Remaining comments cover best-effort policy, SQUASH-only ruleset, unreadable reviews counting as approved, base.sha not advancing, strict checks/dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push, and updateBranch being async — all external facts not visible in code.

Same call order (get → listReviews → compare → updateBranch → graphql enable), each call best-effort via try/catch with core.warning, PR number from process.env.PR_NUMBER; model stated 'No behaviour change — same fallbacks, same messages, same order.'

'prettier and gx lint aren't installed here (no node_modules, no gx binary)', 'No openspec CLI in this environment'; node --check passed; diff shows well-formed spec/scenario markdown and an unchanged workflow step structure.

judge.reason: The replay ran both review passes, fixed or deliberately resolved every finding with the user's delegation, extracted the step into script/enableAutoMerge.js with named functions carrying the logic and only non-obvious comments, and committed with push blocked by the missing remote. Doubt remains on c4 (a 3-line comment was kept rather than none, though the user accepted it) and on the unrunnable lint/validate checks.
